modules.title: Introduction to Digital Literacy
modules.subtitle: Build your foundation in digital technology
modules.description: Learn the essentials of using digital devices, from smartphones to computers. Understand how to navigate the internet, use basic apps, and communicate digitally with confidence.
objectives: Identify common digital devices and explain what each is used for
Navigate a smartphone and a computer confidently
Connect to the internet and browse for information
Send your first digital message to a friend or family member

lessons.title: What is Digital Literacy?
lessons.summary: Why digital skills matter for work, learning, and everyday life in Zambia.

lessons.title: Getting to Know Your Device
lessons.summary: Parts of a smartphone and computer, turning on, and basic controls.

lessons.title: Connecting to the Internet
lessons.summary: Wi-Fi and mobile data, opening a browser, and searching the web.

lessons.title: Your First Online Communication
lessons.summary: Sending a message and making your first video or voice call.

modules.title: Online Safety & Cyber Hygiene
modules.subtitle: Protect yourself in the digital world
modules.description: Learn how to create strong passwords, recognize scams and phishing attempts, protect your personal data, and practice safe online behavior across all platforms.
objectives: Create and manage strong, unique passwords
Recognize scams, phishing messages, and fake links
Configure privacy settings on social media
Protect your personal and financial data online

lessons.title: Strong Passwords
lessons.summary: Building passwords that are hard to guess and easy to remember.

lessons.title: Spotting Scams & Phishing
lessons.summary: Real examples of fraud targeting Zambian users and how to avoid them.

lessons.title: Social Media Privacy
lessons.summary: Controlling who sees your posts, photos, and personal details.

lessons.title: Protecting Your Data
lessons.summary: Safe browsing, secure connections, and what to do if you are hacked.

modules.title: Digital Communication & Collaboration
modules.subtitle: Connect and work with others effectively
modules.description: Master the tools and etiquette for digital communication. From professional email use to video conferencing and collaborative platforms.
objectives: Write clear, professional emails
Use messaging apps like WhatsApp effectively
Join and host video calls with confidence
Collaborate with others on shared documents

lessons.title: Email Essentials
lessons.summary: Creating an account, subject lines, attachments, and etiquette.

lessons.title: Messaging Platforms
lessons.summary: Group chats, voice notes, and staying organized.

lessons.title: Video Conferencing
lessons.summary: Joining Zoom or Google Meet calls and presenting yourself well.

lessons.title: Collaborative Tools
lessons.summary: Working together on shared documents in real time.

modules.title: Information & Media Literacy
modules.subtitle: Think critically about what you see online
modules.description: Develop critical thinking skills to identify misinformation, verify sources, and share content responsibly in the complex information landscape.
objectives: Evaluate online information critically before believing it
Verify sources and check facts
Share content responsibly without spreading rumours
Recognize bias, clickbait, and misinformation

lessons.title: What is Misinformation?
lessons.summary: Fake news, doctored images, and how false claims spread.

lessons.title: Fact-Checking Tools
lessons.summary: Practical ways to verify a story before you share it.

lessons.title: Responsible Sharing
lessons.summary: The impact of forwarding unverified content.

lessons.title: Critical Thinking Online
lessons.summary: Asking the right questions about what you read.

modules.title: Digital Financial Literacy
modules.subtitle: Manage money safely in the digital age
modules.description: Learn to use mobile money services safely, make secure digital payments, recognize financial fraud, and protect yourself during online transactions.
objectives: Use mobile money services such as Airtel Money and MTN MoMo safely
Make secure digital payments and transfers
Recognize and avoid financial fraud
Protect yourself during online transactions

lessons.title: Mobile Money Basics
lessons.summary: Sending, receiving, and keeping your mobile money PIN safe.

lessons.title: Digital Payments
lessons.summary: Paying bills, buying airtime, and online transfers.

lessons.title: Avoiding Financial Fraud
lessons.summary: Common money scams and red flags to watch for.

lessons.title: Safe Online Shopping
lessons.summary: Buying online securely and protecting your card details.

modules.title: Productivity & Work Readiness
modules.subtitle: Build skills for the modern workplace
modules.description: Develop practical workplace skills including document creation, internet research, online applications, and building a professional digital profile.
objectives: Create and edit documents and spreadsheets
Research information effectively online
Complete online application and registration forms
Build a professional CV and digital profile

lessons.title: Document Creation
lessons.summary: Word processing and spreadsheets for everyday tasks.

lessons.title: Effective Online Research
lessons.summary: Finding reliable information and saving it properly.

lessons.title: Filling Online Forms
lessons.summary: Applying for jobs, services, and registrations online.

lessons.title: Building Your Digital CV
lessons.summary: Creating a CV and a professional online presence.

modules.title: Digital Entrepreneurship
modules.subtitle: Grow your business using digital tools
modules.description: Leverage social media for marketing, engage customers online, use digital business tools, and start selling through e-commerce platforms.
objectives: Market a business using social media
Engage and grow customers online
Use digital tools to run a small business
Start selling products or services online

lessons.title: Social Media Marketing
lessons.summary: Building a business page and reaching customers for free.

lessons.title: Customer Engagement
lessons.summary: Responding to customers and building trust online.

lessons.title: Digital Business Tools

lessons.title: E-Commerce Basics

modules.title: Responsible Digital Citizenship
modules.subtitle: Be a positive force in the digital world
modules.description: Understand your digital rights and responsibilities, practice ethical technology use, promote inclusive online participation, and maintain mental wellbeing.
objectives: Understand your digital rights and responsibilities
Use technology ethically and respectfully
Promote inclusive, positive online participation
Maintain healthy digital habits and wellbeing

lessons.title: Digital Rights & Responsibilities
lessons.summary: What you are entitled to online and what is expected of you.

lessons.title: Ethical Technology Use
lessons.summary: Respecting others, copyright, and honest behaviour online.
